entities.summary: Jordany V. Valdespin is a Dominican former professional baseball second baseman and outfielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Mets and Miami Marlins. He was suspended for 50 games during the 2013 Biogenesis baseball scandal.
